text: Computer Science and Technology is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates computer theory, software engineering, hardware design, and information technology. It belongs to the category of computer science in engineering (professional code: 080901), with a four-year duration of study and confers a Bachelor of Engineering degree. This major is based on computational theory and focuses on the design, development and application of computer systems, covering core areas such as algorithm design, software development, hardware architecture and data processing. It is a core supporting discipline for promoting the development of cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, big data and the Internet of Things
